title: Beijing-style Air Quality (PRSA schema)
description: Data is SYNTHETIC unless real UCI PRSA CSVs were mounted (see the API /health air_quality_data).

targets.query: from(bucket: "air-quality") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "air_quality" and r._field == "PM2.5") |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.station, set: ${station:json})) |> group(columns: ["station"]) |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false) |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r._value, station: r.station})) |> yield(name: "PM2.5")

from(bucket: "air-quality") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "air_quality" and r._field == "PM2.5") |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.station, set: ${station:json})) |> group(columns: ["station"]) |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false) |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r._value, station: r.station})) |> yield(name: "PM2.5")
